## Fixed figures
- Disks: 10000 disks, assumed MTTF 30 years → 0.91 failures/day ≈ about one per day.
- Tail amplification: 1 − 0.99^100 = 0.634 → about 63%.
- Twitter, circa 2012: 4600 tweets/s avg (> 12000 peak), 300000 timeline reads/s,
  avg 75 followers → 345000 insertions/s; ≈ 65 reads per tweet; celebrity 30000000 followers.
